cues.zhText: 在病理学家眼里，急性阑尾炎的本质，始终绕不开两个核心动作——“变质”和“渗出”。
cues.enText: In pathology, acute appendicitis centers on two processes: tissue injury and exudation.

cues.zhText: 在典型的梗阻—感染过程中，以粪石为主堵塞管腔，腔内压随之急剧升高。缺血与细菌感染可造成黏膜坏死、破溃、脱落并形成溃疡，这就是“变质”。
cues.enText: In the classic obstruction-infection model, a fecalith typically blocks the lumen, causing luminal pressure to rise sharply. Ischemia and bacterial infection can lead to mucosal necrosis, breakdown and sloughing, with ulceration. This is tissue injury.

cues.zhText: 组胺、缓激肽、前列腺素与趋化因子等炎症介质参与反应。血管扩张充血，通透性升高，血浆被动漏出。中性粒细胞受炎症介质与趋化因子引导，依次边集、滚动、黏附，最后以阿米巴样运动经内皮间隙游出。这是主动渗出。
cues.enText: Histamine, bradykinin, prostaglandins and chemotactic factors take part in the inflammatory response. Vessels dilate and become congested and more permeable, so plasma leaks out passively. Guided by inflammatory mediators and chemotactic factors, neutrophils marginate, roll and adhere. They then actively leave through endothelial gaps by amoeboid movement.

cues.zhText: 化脓性炎症时，中性粒细胞可浸润阑尾壁全层。链球菌等细菌可产生链激酶和透明质酸酶。链激酶激活纤溶酶原，促进纤维素降解；透明质酸酶可降解透明质酸。炎症可沿组织间隙迅速蔓延，穿透肌层直达浆膜。这种弥漫蔓延，就是“蜂窝织性”名称的由来。
cues.enText: In suppurative inflammation, neutrophils can infiltrate the full appendiceal wall. Bacteria such as streptococci may produce streptokinase and hyaluronidase. Streptokinase activates plasminogen, promoting fibrin breakdown. Hyaluronidase breaks down hyaluronic acid. Inflammation can spread rapidly through tissue spaces and across the muscle to the serosa. This diffuse spread is why it is called phlegmonous.

cues.zhText: 这种阑尾炎的本质是化脓性炎症。渗出物以变性、坏死的中性粒细胞为主，这些是脓细胞。脓细胞与交织成网的纤维素混在一起，共同构成纤维素性脓性渗出物。肉眼看到的，就是阑尾表面的灰黄色脓苔。
highlightZh: 变性、坏死的中性粒细胞
cues.enText: This type of appendicitis is a suppurative inflammation. The exudate consists mainly of degenerated and necrotic neutrophils, called pus cells. Pus cells mix with a mesh of fibrin to form a fibrinopurulent exudate. To the naked eye, it forms a grayish-yellow purulent coating on the appendix.
